quarterly_data.signal: Sysgration BBU update (company): 3kW, 5.5kW and 11kW BBU products are advancing through qualification and market adoption, with supply readiness aligned with customer requirements; the Plano, Texas facility (operational since 1Q26) is production-ready, with a roadmap covering 11kW, 5.5kW, 3kW and HVDC solutions. quarterly_data.signal: Sysgration drones (company): several ground control station (GCS) projects are under development, with the first entering mass production in 4Q26, targeting law enforcement and public safety; its military-grade rugged GCS delivers 48 TOPS of AI computing power in 2026, scaling to 100 TOPS in 2027; AI compute modules (Qualcomm Dragonwing-based SoM and SMARC solutions) are being co-developed with customers, with volume ramp-up expected in 2028. Under its strategic partnership with Quantum Systems (fixed-wing medium- and long-range reconnaissance) it targets two project wins in 2026, and a drone production line is planned in Taiwan for 2Q-3Q26, supporting local assembly and module production for final assembly in the U.S.; commercialization begins in 4Q26.
